title: Reject unexpected primed Lean axiom reports
body:
## Summary

The Lean axiom audit can report `PASS 1 declarations` while its actual compiler output contains a second theorem depending on a forbidden axiom. Both output regexes excluded apostrophes from names, so a primed name such as `bad'` was invisible to the report count and axiom checks. A normal audited theorem named `actual'` also failed with `reported 0/1`. Lean permits apostrophes in identifiers; see its [identifier syntax](https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/latest/Source-Files-and-Modules/).

For example, this valid Lean 4.21.0 source compiles successfully and prints both real axiom reports, but the original CLI reports success:

```lean
import Init
theorem good : True := True.intro
axiom custom : False
theorem bad' : False := custom
#print axioms good
#print axioms bad' #check Nat
```

The current source-query reader collects `good` from this fixture; the extra primed report must still be rejected by the output checker. Match names through the report delimiter, allowing apostrophes while keeping names within one output line. The existing report count, expected-name set, and axiom allowlist then reject the extra `bad'` report. The corrected CLI exits 1 and reports `custom`; the original exits 0 with `PASS 1 declarations`.

This changes only output parsing and adds a separate regression module. Pending #3602 addresses raw strings in the source-query lexer; that lexer and its tests are untouched here. The two fixes cover complementary boundaries. The selected result, theorem sources, frozen inputs, source maps, and certificates are unchanged. This remains a bounded audit helper, not a complete Lean parser or authentication against arbitrary hostile elaborators or loggers.

## Test plan

- [x] Negative control on canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`: the new test module produced 7 failures and 7 errors, including the actual Lean false PASS above and rejection of valid primed declarations.
- [x] `LEAN_AUDIT_BIN=/path/to/lean-4.21.0/bin python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_lean_axiom*.py' -v` — all 8 tests passed, including both live Lean test groups.
- [x] The same two modules with `python3.12 -I -O -B ... -q` — all 8 tests passed.
- [x] Real Lean positive controls cover an axiom-free primed theorem and a doubly primed theorem using allowed axioms. Real Lean negative controls cover the extra primed report, a custom axiom, and `sorryAx`. Every fixture compiles successfully before its audit outcome is checked.
- [x] Parser controls cover ordinary names, namespace/internal/multiple apostrophes, multiline axiom lists, malformed extra primed reports, duplicates, name mismatch, delimiter ambiguity, and CR/LF boundaries.
- [x] Existing comment/string controls and the three existing audit query inventories pass unchanged; `git diff --check` passes.
- [x] Combined this output fix with pending #3602 in a disposable fixture: all 12 parser and live Lean tests passed; the patch also applies cleanly to #3602.
- [ ] Hosted CI, full formal-project builds, and the selected mathematical cold replay were not run for this output-parser change.

Environment: macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14, Lean 4.21.0 (`6741444a63ee`). Without `LEAN_AUDIT_BIN`, the live tests explicitly skip; the parser controls still run.

## Attribution and overlap

Retain the helper authors and @ywz65's source-scanner work in #2523. This correction extends the existing output checks independently of @roger-sato's pending #3602 source-lexer fix. Canonical base remains `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The fresh overlap snapshot covers 344 open PRs, 2,959 closed/merged PRs, and 2,453 Discussions; targeted all-state searches found no equivalent primed-report repair. This is bounded search coverage, not a general novelty claim.

Prepared by roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
